legend: Adult rhabdomyoma is composed of polygonal rhabdomyoblastic cells.

Tumour of the tongue in a 67-year-old man. Large polygonal cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm, small round vesicular nuclei, and well-defined cellular borders. The cytoplasm may be vacuolated (spider cells) or may contain cross-striations.
Tumour of the tongue in a 67-year-old man. Low-power view showing large polygonal cells with abundant granular cytoplasm, which is partly vacuolated, with well-defined cellular borders.
